༄༅/ /bla ma rgyal ba 'dus pa dang thugs kyi nor bu thun mong gi drag sgrub me'i 'khor lo'i phrin las nyung ngur bsdus pa zab lam dgongs 'dus zhes bya

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla ma rgyal ba 'dus pa dang thugs kyi nor bu thun mong gi drag sgrub me'i 'khor lo'i phrin las nyung ngur bsdus pa zab lam dgongs 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de ba dhā ki nī yai/ 'od gsal dbyings las bde chen sku /'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol ba// rdo rje srin po gtsug rgyan du// rtag bzhugs bka' yi gnang ba stsol// 'dir gter chen zhig po gling pa dang chos rje gling pa zung gi zab gter las tshig don gcig par byon pa'i bla ma drag po me 'khor gyi phrin las la 'jug pa na/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bshom ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su dkyil 'khor gzhung mthun bris pa'i dbus su zangs bum bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs thag dang bcas pa/ shar du dpal gtor zur gsum padma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan cing spod chang gis bran pa/ lhor thod pa dum gcig dkar mngar chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba'i kha dar dmar dang me long gis bkab pa/ nub tu gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can tshe ril tshe chang gis bskor ba/ byang du drag po'i sku 'bag sngags byang dang bcas pa bkod/ mda' ral gri sogs rgyan rdzas dang*/ sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi nang mchod pa spyi ltar bsham/ dbang dang 'brel na dbang chog nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ tshogs skong tsam la ni gtor mchod kho na la brten pas chog go /phrin las dngos la sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ dang po la lnga'i thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gu ru drag po'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par gyur/ na mo: brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla mar bcas: dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam lha: bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro ma: rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: dbang drag padma bsgrubs nas kyang: log 'dren dgra bgegs bsgral nas ni: gzhan don skyong bar sems bskyed do: gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skyabs yul rang la thim par gyur/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ bgegs gtor raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin brlab/

sarba bighnān ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa 'gugs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngos la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: kun bzang khyab bdal chen po'i rang bzhin la: las kyi dbang gis blta bar mi dbang ba'i: bdud dang log 'dren 'byung po gang yin pa: lan chags re ba'i gtor ma 'di khyer la: dkyil 'khor 'di yi 'khor yug 'da' ma byed: gal te rdo rje'i bka' las 'gal gyur na: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur: sumbha ni 'i drag sngags brjod la bskrad/ bzhi pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag padma'i sku: sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros: steng 'og rdo rje'i gur du gyur: ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung gis: phyogs mtshams ma lus rab gtams shing: khro bo khro mos gnam sa gang: snod bcud lha yi gzhal yas las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kro dha tīkṣ+ṇa badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa byin dbab cing mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas: bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas: byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur du gsol: gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya ā be sha ya a ā: mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bhandha 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya siddhi sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ puṣpe dhū paṃ ā lo ke gandhe nai bidya shabda ma hā pū dza hoḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā pū dza ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza ho: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun yod pa'i dang po dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med spros bral las: kun khyab brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom: zung 'jug rang sems hūm̐ dmar las: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ 'phros: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng: bhrūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang: drag po'i rgyan bkod yongs su rdzogs: phyi nang me phung smug nag 'bar: de nang 'khor lo gnyis rim gyi: dbus su gru gsum mthing nag la: pad nyi sde brgyad dregs pa'i steng: rang rig gnam lcags rdo rje ni: rtse dgu mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan: yongs gyur padma thod phreng rtsal: gtum drag me yi 'khor lo can: sku mdog dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'dor stabs bgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum 'khrug cing smin ma dang: sma ra ral pa me 'od 'phro: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje phyar: g.yon pas lcags kyi sdig pa 'gyed: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil: thod sbrul rus rgyan zhing gos sogs: dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan: g.yon nas rdo rje phag mo 'khril: mthing nag gri thod phag zhal sgrog: de yi spyi gtsug bya khyung mthing: me gshog gnam lcags tshwa tshwa 'phro: de steng rigs bdag mtha' yas dmar: mnyam gzhag longs sku pad zlar bzhugs: dpral bar gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: 'jam dpal ser po ral gri dang: 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus: rta mgrin dmar po rta zhal mtshan: gri thod 'dzin pa'i mgrin par ā: thugs kar mchod rten bum pa ru: phyag rdor mthing nag rdo rje dang: dril bu dkur brten thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar rin chen 'bar ba'i dbus:

mkha' 'gro sde lnga gri thod 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan ldan thugs kar swā: gsang gnas rdo rje rgya gram dbus: me dbal smug nag tho ba dang: sdigs mdzub me zhags thugs kar hā: yi ge lnga las 'od lnga 'phros: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: lha rnams spyan drangs so sor thim: sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas: snang ba mtha' yas sku la thim: yongs rdzogs dbang bskur thob par gyur: bdag bskyed kho na la 'di tsam gyis chog /mdun dkyil dang 'brel na/ de yi phyi rim rtsibs bzhi la: rdo rje rin chen padma dang: karma drag po rtsal bzhi po: dkar ser dmar ljang dur khrod chas: g.yas pas rdo rje be con gri: tho ba g.yon pas lcags sdig 'dzin: de rgyab 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams su: go cha'i lha las he hrīḥhūm̐: hūm̐ 'phros gshin rje rta mgrin rgyal: phyag rdor me dbal rnams su gsal: mu khyud pad nyi ro gdan steng: lte ba'i lha las hrīḥlnga 'phros: mkha' 'gro sde lnga gar stabs sgyur: thams cad ma 'dres lham mer gsal: slar yang thugs srog hūm̐ dmar las: 'od 'phros hūm̐ nag 'jig rten gang: yaksha me dbal skur gyur nas: gdon bgegs sde brgyad gzir bar gyur: oṃ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī hūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te hūm̐: āḥhūm̐: badzra hūm̐: yaksha hūm̐: raksha hūm̐: pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdza: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod smug nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa 'dul mdzad dbang drag thod phreng rtsal: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: 'dod chags rakta'i rgya mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs: zhe sdang keng rus bkram pa'i klong nas bzhengs: gti mug sha chen spungs pa'i dbus nas bzhengs: nga rgyal me ltar 'bar ba'i dbyings nas bzhengs: phrag dog rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i nang nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs=

dam sri pho mo 'dul phyir gshegs= yum chen rdo rje phag mo gshegs= go cha lha lnga drag po rigs bzhi dang: chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: badzra gu ru shrī he ru ka padma kro dha sa pa ri bā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na: ti ra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: ma hā gu ru dbang drag thod phreng rtsal: 'khor bcas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag padma thod phreng drag po'i sku: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing: 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa: 'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: bla ma dbang drag padma'i dkyil 'khor du: me tog bdug spos snang gsal mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan la sogs yid 'ong rdzas: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin: snang srid nam mkha' thams cad yongs bkang nas: dgyes pa bskang phyir mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐: nang mchod ni/ hūm̐: bla ma dbang drag thod phreng dkyil 'khor la: dam rdzas mchog gi gtor ma ri ltar spungs: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa mtsho ltar bskyil: rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ rba rlabs 'khrugs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen bshams: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med mtha' yas pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod par 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta pañtsa a mṛta rakta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐: bla ma dbang drag thod phreng dkyil 'khor la: yab yum gnyis med bde stong rab sbyar nas: mkha' gsang byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i mchog: sku lus dgyes pa bskang phyir mchod par 'bul: bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya ma hā pū tsa ho: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐:

ma hā gu ru dbang drag thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog 'dra la: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha rab tu 'khrol: zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku yi sham thabs can: dbu skra dmar ser lcang lo gyen du 'khyil: de la tshwa tshwa dmar po skar ltar 'khrugs: spyan rtsa dmar nag gdangs mig gyen du bsgril: bar snang khams kyi gdon tshogs brlag par byed: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams pa yis: ri rab chen po kun kyang thal bar bsnyil: phyag g.yon lcags sdig kha dgu bsnams pa ni: yaksha raksha'i gnod pa thams cad 'dul: bgegs 'dul dbang drag padma'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi shes rab ma: dgyes sbyor gsang ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs mchog bdag po rgyal ba 'od dpag med: gsung mchog 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi sku rnams 'dus pa'i dpal: mkhyen rab 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rnams 'dus pa'i dpal: rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rnams 'dus pa'i dpal: gsang bdag gtum po'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan 'dus pa'i dpal: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: yaksha me dbal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rje'i 'od zer las: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: khro bo srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa dzap bzla ba ni/ bdag bskyed gsang bdag thugs ka'i nyi steng hūm̐ dmar nag la sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ rgyal ba rnams mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs nas lhar gyur te sngags sgra sgrog par mos la/ bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī hūm̐:

chos gling zab lam ltar na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pa tsam khyad par ro// sgrub pa ni/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags phreng thon te mdun bskyed gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs srog dang sbyor mtshams brgyud/ rang gi thugs kar thim pa bar ma chad pa lu gu rgyud du 'khor ba dang/ yang sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul du 'phros/ dngos grub kyi tshul du tshur 'dus te rgyal bsen thams cad tshar bcad lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bran du 'khol bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra hūm̐ yaksha hūm̐ raksha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na hūm̐: las sbyor sde brgyad 'dul phyir rtsa sngags kyi sham bur (sde brgyad so so'i snying ga nas ni/ srog gi gzungs te zhal du bltems: zhes dmigs la/) 'di nyid btags la/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po'i srog la hab: snying la rbad: lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya chings nan: rgyal 'gong gdug pa gnad la gzir ba'i phyir rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ (me rlung spu gri so bsnol bar: shin tu mi srun dkor bdag rigs: sde brgyad 'byung po gnad nas gzir: ces sogs dmigs pa'i 'phrul shes pas/) oṃ badzra yaksha kro dha hūm̐: badzra raksha tsitta zung zung: kha rag mṛ sha rbad rbad: khu na duṃ bu shig shig: dha na rā tsa tsitta phyung rbad rbad: bzlog na rā tsa tsitta rbad rbad gtubs gtubs rā tsa'i tsitta gtubs: zhes bzla/ de yang bsnyen pa 'bum/ sgrub pa 'bum phrag gsum/ las sbyor khri'am stong phrag lnga sogs bzla bar gsungs/ thun mthar kha skong stong tshigs spyi ltar dang*/ bar 'dir gter srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bcu yod pa'i dang po tshogs mchod ni/ chu chang nang mchod kyis bran la/

oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa: swa bhā ba sogs kyis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las bandha yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ bdag gi thugs las oṃ dkar po 'phros/ tshogs mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan zhing khams thams cad gang*/ āḥdamar po 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis 'jig rten gang*/ hūm̐ sngon po 'phros/ mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bas rgyal ba rnams mchod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: gsum gyis byin brlabs la tshogs mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: dbang drag padma thod phreng rtsal: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'dir: padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka padma kro dha sa pa ri bā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: tiṣṭha lhan:

dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag padma thod phreng rtsal: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa skong bshags ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: yang gsang dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang: mchod rdzas bsgrub rdzas gzhung bzhin bshams pa 'dis: dbang drag padma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yum chen rdo rje phag mo'i thugs= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs= 'khor tshogs dam can rnams kyi thugs= g.yar dam nyams chag ma lus sor stsol cig: hūm̐: bla ma dbang drag lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig chag nyams kun: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya ho: tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ 'gugs bstim spyi ltar byas la phur bu thogs te/ hūm̐: dbang drag padma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po me ltar 'bar: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying 'dzin: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i sri la sogs: rdul du rlogs la dbyings su sgrol: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka padma kro dha badzra nṛ tri dgra bgegs la sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭa: ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti pū dza khā hi khā hi: de nas brda'i 'bul len spyi ltar byas te tshogs la rol/ lhag ma 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir brlabs la/ hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe dbang drag padma thod phreng gis: las kyi rdo rje byed par dbang bskur ba'i: ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging gi tshogs: thugs dam bzhin du mchod kyis 'dir byon la: rnam lnga'i longs spyod lhag ma'i pha 'bab bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod:

utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag padma yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku gshegs la: khyed kyi thugs rje'i brtse bas bdag la dgongs: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol: dregs pa sde brgyad gnod byed pho mo dang: dgra bgegs log 'dren pho mo rdul du rlogs: dbang drag padma yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: thugs dam rgyud bskul gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod: gsum pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe ri bo gnam lcags rtse mo ru: bcom ldan khrag 'thung padma he ru kas: log 'dren ru dra pho mo bsgral pa'i tshe: dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyis: so so'i srog snying phul nas dam bcas tshe: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa bar ma la: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu ru: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang drag padma'i sku ru bzhengs pa'i tshe: dregs pa sde brgyad snang srid lha 'dre yis: so so'i srog snying phul nas dam bcas tshe: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og rtsub 'gyur bskal pa'i tha ma la: rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng gis: slob ma rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug la: rtsa gsum bla ma'i bka' gtad mdzad pa'i tshe: bdud btsan klu gsum la sogs bka' srung gis: so so'i srog snying phul nas dam bcas tshe: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bzhi pa bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/

bhyo: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: slob dpon padma thod phreng dang: rlangs chen dpal seng spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: dal kha chod la rims kha sgyur: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa rta bro bya ba ni/ gtor gzhong sbubs pa'i 'og tu dam sri bkug la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gdug pa zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po la: dbang drag padma khro bos bro brdungs pas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar brlag par mdzod: st+wambha raksha mā ra ya nan: drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma drag po rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa ltar byon/ sku gsung thugs las byin rlabs 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par gyur par bsams la/ gtor ma spyi bor bzung la/ oṃ: dgongs shig dbang drag padma thod phreng rtsal: bdag ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dam tshig can: khyed dang bdag nyid g.yar dam gcig pas na: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor ma lus mtha' ru phyin: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nas: lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wā ka siddhi ā: tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrī: gnas lngar bzhag la gtor zan bdud rtsi myang*/ bdun pa gtang rag nongs bshags ni/ mdun bskyed yod na mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol: ma 'byor nyams dang 'gal 'khrul dang: lhag chad nyes ltung ci mchis pa: mthol bshags dam pa bzhes nas kyang: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:

ces dang yig brgya brjod/ brgyad pa gshegs bsdu ni/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa ras bris sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mtha' nas rim 'dus hūm̐ la thim: de yang rim yal chos dbyings ngang: slar yang rdo rje khro bor shar: dgu pa smon lam ni/ na mo: bdag nyid rig 'dzin sngags 'chang sgrub pa pos: dbang drag padma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs la sogs: dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: yon tan kun rdzogs phrin las kun 'grub shog: bcu pa bkra shis ni/ ho: chos sku spros bral skye med mtha' bral ba: dbang drag padma mchog gi bkra shis shog: longs spyod rdzogs sku mnyam yangs brjod las 'das: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: sprul sku kun khyab 'gro don phyogs bcur mdzad: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog: phrin las rnam bzhi yon tan kun 'byung ba: bka' srung dam can rnams kyi bkra shis shog: sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel las kun sgrub: gter srung las byed rnams kyi bkra shis shog: ces brjod cing me tog 'thor la rol mo bya'o: 'di byas nongs pa snying nas bshags: dge bas skal ldan skye bo kun: 'di spyod las bzhi mthar phyin nas: dbang drag mchog gi rig 'dzin shog /tshul 'di zhig gling rgyal ba 'dus pa dang chos gling zab lam thugs kyi nor bu'i chos sder tshig don zhu dag pher pa byon pa phyi ma la las byang mi bzhugs pas chos rje gling pas dbang 'bum padma rā ga'i phreng bar gter kha gnyis chu bo gcig bsdus la 'don cha sogs zhig gling lugs sor bzhag gnang ba shin tu legs kyang cung zad bsdus ches pas/ 'dir gter gzhung gi rkang tshang bar byas te shrī de bī ko ṭi tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub sder/ phyogs med ris med sprang chal gyi rig pa 'dzin pa padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
